blocks.text: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Sunday issued a fresh ultimatum to Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa to surrender or face an intensified manhunt. “We’ve been talking for a year. Enough talk. Surrender or face the music,” Remulla told the Inquirer in a Viber message. He warned that authorities would pursue Dela Rosa without restraint if […]...
